failures.observed: P0001 CP7_CREDIT_REFUND_RECOGNITION_CHANGED at assert_refund_operation_v1 line 32 (from post_initial_refund in native_return_complete)
failures.expected: return of 100 settled as REFUND: I 100, E 400, AR 0, PAID, cash -100
failures.cause: native_return_complete stores the refund binding hash over the invoice's whole profile (pg_jsonb_sha256(a->actual_objects)), while both retained readers, assert_refund_operation_v1 (06_finish_and_closed_routes.sql:31-35) and the refund poster (refund/01_initial_refund.proposal.sql:163-166), compare the profile sorted by kind and id WITHOUT consumption objects. A single-root invoice has no consumption objects before its own refund, so the two agree; the credit-paid invoice's profile carries the incoming APPLY as a consumption object of the upstream cohort, so the retained check correctly refused.
failures.fix: C14: one counted substitution in native_return_complete so the stored hash is exactly the readers' manifest. The profile is already sorted by kind and id, so without consumption objects the hash is unchanged.

failures.observed: cp6_restored False, advisor_gate False: the retained lower removal (cp7_consumer_owning_install._lock_private_tables, LOCK ... IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT) raised LockNotAvailable on cp7_sales.requests; the T3 gate then reported installed False and backup_restore_drill False (T3_RUNTIME_SCHEMA_ACL_CHANGED) because the stage chain was still installed
failures.expected: exact pre-use removal and CP6 restore, as in every earlier run of the chain
failures.classification: neither (a) nor (b) proven: another backend held a lock on cp7_sales.requests at that moment and the run did not record which one. Every case and the race reported no leaked session or advisory lock. No guard was changed.
failures.fix: Diagnostics plus a bounded wait in the slice C probe: before removal it polls pg_locks/pg_stat_activity for other backends holding locks on cp7 relations (up to 90 s) and records them in pre_removal_lock_wait. The retained NOWAIT removal runs unchanged afterwards. If the next run fails the same way, the record names the holder.
